defs:
  RUNS_DIR := /workspace/hdcs/runs (conf default, env HDCS_RUNS_DIR override)
  ARCHIVE_DIR := /workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive (conf default, env HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR override)
  AGE_DAYS := 14, PATTERN := *.txt, KEEP := 50; conf = exactly these five KEY=VALUE lines
invariants:

  A2_env: pure bash + coreutils (find, cmp, realpath, cksum); ∄ logrotate invocation; ∄ root
  A4_pathlaw: refuse RUNS_DIR==ARCHIVE_DIR, containment ∀ direction, degenerate ('', '.', '/'); refusal cites A-number, zero writes; set-but-empty env var = refusal (¬ fall back to conf)
  A5_mirror: ∀ path -> archived bytes == source bytes (cmp), filename preserved + rotation suffix; move-once by age threshold => 2nd --apply zero-action no-op, ARCHIVE_DIR byte-identical (cksum)
  A6_verify: exit 0 iff (a) conf parses ∧ (b) no PATTERN file age ≥ AGE_DAYS under RUNS_DIR ∧ (c) archived files exist ∧ listing consistent; nonzero otherwise
  A7_limits: exotic filenames / concurrent writes during apply = KNOWN_LIMITATIONS, ¬ FAIL

text:
state: s0 := packet hdcs/1 validated; invariants A1,A2,A4,A5,A6,A7 binding; conf keys fixed (RUNS_DIR=/workspace/hdcs/runs, ARCHIVE_DIR=/workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive, AGE_DAYS=14, PATTERN=*.txt, KEEP=50); no artifacts exist yet.
Δ := 
1. Write hdcs-runs-rotation.conf with exactly the five KEY=VALUE lines (RUNS_DIR, ARCHIVE_DIR, AGE_DAYS=14, PATTERN=*.txt, KEEP=50). → expected: file parses line-by-line as KEY=VALUE; exactly 5 keys; no extra keys/comments beyond header.
2. Write rotate-hdcs-runs.sh: (a) parse conf via source-safe read; (b) env HDCS_RUNS_DIR/HDCS_ARCHIVE_DIR override conf; set-but-empty env = refusal citing A4, exit nonzero, zero writes; (c) path law: realpath both dirs; refuse if equal, either contains the other (∀ direction), or either is '', '.', '/' — refusal message cites A4, exit nonzero, zero writes; (d) default mode DRY-RUN: list would-be moves (find "$RUNS_DIR" -type f -name "$PATTERN" -mtime +$((AGE_DAYS-1))), print plan, create nothing, write nothing (A1); (e) --apply: mkdir -p ARCHIVE_DIR, mirror relative subpaths, mv each candidate preserving filename + suffix .1 (bump suffix if target exists), cmp source-vs-archived copy before removing source (A5); (f) second --apply finds zero candidates → no-op, ARCHIVE_DIR cksum-identical; (g) no logrotate, no root, bash+coreutils only (A2). → expected: bash -n passes; DRY-RUN on seeded tree prints plan and leaves RUNS_DIR/ARCHIVE_DIR mtimes+contents unchanged; --apply moves only files with mtime ≥ 14d; archived bytes cmp-identical; rerun --apply exits 0 with "0 moved" and cksum of ARCHIVE_DIR unchanged.
3. Write verify-rotation.sh: exit 0 iff (a) conf parses with exactly 5 keys ∧ (b) find RUNS_DIR -name PATTERN -mtime +13 yields nothing ∧ (c) every file in ARCHIVE_DIR exists and listing matches a stored/expected manifest check; else exit nonzero with reason line. → expected: exit 0 post-apply; exit nonzero when a ≥14d file is planted
